vignette: Raj, a 49-year-old South Asian man and military medic, has been struggling with symptoms of post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) following physical abuse from his romantic partner. His experience is deeply intertwined with the traumatic event itself, which occurred several months ago when Raj's partner became increasingly abusive during an argument that escalated into a violent confrontation. On that fateful day, Raj's partner had accused him of not being present enough for their relationship, citing his demanding work as a military medic and the long hours he spent away from home. The tension between them had been building for weeks, but this time it culminated in physical violence. Raj vividly recalls the overwhelming smell of sweat mixed with fear that permeated the air. He remembers how quickly things escalated—his partner's clenched fists, the forceful impact of their hands against his body, and the excruciating pain he felt each time they struck him. Since then, Raj has found himself constantly on edge. Ordinary sounds, like a car backfiring or a loud bang, startle him intensely. He often finds it difficult to fall asleep because he feels an overwhelming need to stay alert, as if something is always waiting in the shadows to attack again. This hyper-vigilance extends beyond his home; even at work, where he usually feels secure, Raj has started to experience intense anxiety whenever he encounters someone with authority or any familiar face from his personal life. To cope with these overwhelming feelings, Raj has adopted several avoidance behaviors. He avoids wearing clothes that remind him of the traumatic event, and as a result, he no longer wears his military uniform at home. Instead, he opts for loose-fitting, comfortable clothing to minimize physical discomfort and emotional distress. Exercise, once an integral part of his daily routine, now triggers painful memories and has been abandoned altogether. Raj's social life has also suffered significantly. He avoids gatherings with family and friends, fearing that they might inadvertently remind him of the trauma he endured. This withdrawal from social interactions has led to a strain on his marriage, as well as his relationships with colleagues at work. His wife feels hurt by his increasing distance and lack of willingness to engage in their usual activities. One particular incident at work highlighted the consequences of Raj's avoidance behaviors. During a routine training session for new medics, he was asked to demonstrate emergency care techniques on a mannequin. The realistic scenario triggered intense flashbacks, causing him to relive the physical abuse and emotional distress he had experienced. He felt physically and emotionally overwhelmed, leading him to abruptly leave the session. His colleagues noticed his sudden departure but did not understand the reasons behind it, creating an awkward atmosphere. The trauma has left Raj with a profound sense of meaninglessness in his life. Nothing seems to bring him joy or purpose anymore. He believes that there is something fundamentally wrong with him as a person and struggles with the notion that those responsible for his suffering have faced no consequences. These negative appraisals have deepened his isolation, making it difficult for him to trust others or engage in meaningful interactions. What finally pushed Raj to seek help was a particularly severe episode where he found himself unable to function at work. He realized that avoiding his triggers and pushing away loved ones had only exacerbated his symptoms, leading to a complete breakdown of his daily routine. At the core of his fears is the worry that this trauma might define him forever—a fear that overshadows any hope for recovery. Despite these challenges, Raj is hopeful about finding ways to regain control over his life. He seeks help not just to alleviate his symptoms but also to rediscover meaning and purpose in a world where he feels like an outsider. His journey towards healing begins with acknowledging the traumatic event and understanding how it has shaped his current experiences.
